parent_objective: implement source_topup_v1 and run one no-policy top-up source-generation smoke
blocked_by: M1325 admits one bounded top-up generation smoke before source-history materialization
supersedes: direct materialization of the under-target M1323 corpus

public_gates: M1326 must not use private holdout
M1326 must preserve actor input contract
M1326 must use strict source acceptance thresholds
M1326 must report global friction separately
forbidden_shortcuts: do not fabricate global friction coverage
do not hide undercovered family gaps
do not claim high-fidelity tire blowout or load-transfer physics

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: implements and tests source_topup_v1 as a no-policy source-generation smoke
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: source-generation infrastructure only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, closed-loop, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if code changes actor inputs
stop if accepted thresholds are relaxed
stop if global friction is hidden or mislabeled
stop if no accepted-pair improvement over M1323 is produced and no blocker is reported
fallback_plan: if target is met, route to corpus export and plan refresh
if positive but under target, route to result audit before another top-up
if source miner mismatch remains, route global friction to a separate envelope-source branch
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1325 admits one bounded no-policy top-up generation smoke

training_stage.stage_objective: no-policy source repair top-up generation smoke
admission_evidence: M1323 remains at 216 source pairs versus 240 target
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: summary reports accepted pairs and family counts
global friction blocker or diagnostic status is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1326 generates source rows and does not test closed-loop history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: produce source rows for later command-response history materialization
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1325 design and M1326 source smoke only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If top-up fails or global friction remains unsupported, report the gap rather than relaxing thresholds.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: The source_topup_v1 profile can improve M1323 undercovered active-family source coverage under strict no-policy source-mining thresholds.
success_criteria: accepted_separable_pairs >= 240 or accepted_separable_pairs > 216 with explicit gap report
at least two M1323 undercovered active families improve or a blocker is reported
global friction is reported separately as accepted, diagnostic-only, missing, or source-miner mismatch
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: global friction is hidden or mislabeled
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs

commands.name: run_topup_smoke
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.four_wheel_fault_source_shape --fault-profile source_topup_v1 --scenario-profile source_topup_v1 --action-profile source_topup_v1 --sequence-length 9 --run-dir runs/m1326_source_repair_topup_generation_smoke

decision_rule: M1326 passes as infrastructure if source_topup_v1 runs under strict source-mining thresholds and reports either target-met coverage or explicit gap diagnostics without training, PPO, promotion, private holdout use, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion.
